description:
Jianchuan Yiwang is listed as a local tea speciality of Jianchuan county in Dali prefecture, northwestern Yunnan. That is nearly all that is on record about it.

Its method, leaf and taste are undocumented. Treat what is said here about Yunnan greens as a general guide to the class, not a description of this tea.

If you come across it, ask the seller who makes it, where the garden is and which season it was picked. Those answers would tell you more than the name does.
history: Little is documented. It appears in lists of local specialities of Jianchuan county, with no date, maker or account of how it came about.
